name: Tietê (Brazil)
description: Dark blue field with a white stripe at the hoist, charged over the junction with a screamer bird displayed above three indented bars, all counterchanged.
history: Tietê is a municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil. The flag was adopted in 1986 (conceived by Maria do Rosário Diz, winner of a municipal competition, modified by the panel of judges and adopted by Law No. 1,717/86, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: anhuma (screamer) displayed above three indented bars, counterchanged
